payload.reason: The evidence provides information on how static embeddings are calculated using models like Skip-gram with negative sampling and GloVe, which factorize a word-context matrix based on co-occurrence statistics.

claims.text: Static embeddings are calculated using models like Skip-gram with negative sampling and GloVe, which factorize a word-context matrix containing co-occurrence statistics.
Static embeddings create a single representation for each word, which can lead to issues with polysemous words sharing the same vector.
